title: Croatian Pastry Pilaf
description: A hearty and flaky pastry filled with a delicious pilaf, perfect for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped onion and minced garlic over the dough.
In a separate bowl, mix the rice, vegetable broth, tomato paste, dried herbs, salt, and black pepper.
Spoon the pilaf mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the pilaf, pressing the edges to seal.
Bake the pastry for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the pastry rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
